description: This file is a Markdown documentation file describing the `TestStepInfo` class used in Playwright testing framework. It contains explanations, code examples, method descriptions, and parameter details related to the `TestStepInfo` class and its methods such as `attach`, `skip`, and properties like `titlePath`. It does not contain actual source code implementations but rather documentation content.

classes.name: TestStepInfo
classes.description: Provides utilities to control individual test step execution within Playwright tests, including attaching files or data and skipping steps based on conditions.

methods.name: attach
methods.description: Attach a value or a file from disk to the current test step, which can be displayed in test reports. Supports attaching via body or file path, with options for content type.

methods.name: skip
methods.description: Skip the current test step unconditionally or conditionally based on a boolean condition, optionally with a description for reporting.
